We're picking up an intermittent blip that suggests a vessel approaching on the night side, but we can't get a fix on it.|Grayfeather Squadron receives new orders from Starfighter Control|<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>}}
'''Starfighter Control''' was responsible for overseeing the deployment of the [[Commenorian Navy]]'s [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] during the [[Battle of Commenor (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Commenor]]. [[Grayfeather Squadron]] reported the existence of a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] heading for [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] during the battle to Starfighter Control.
